# Contractor onboarding - Vireo Field Services

This page covers the accounts a new contractor needs on day one.

VPN: ask IT to add you to the contractors-vpn group, then sign in at
vpn.vireo-field.example with your badge number as the password.

Time tracking: log hours in FieldClock under the Vireo account.

The contractors-vpn group was renamed partners-vpn in the identity
provider. Memberships carried over; the old name stopped working on
2026-09-28.
